uwp_capture_status: partial: original UWP app built (Release/.NET Native), launched and rendered correctly (window title 'Lamp Device C# Sample', PID 16660) - a real visual golden of the landing scenario was captured (parity/baseline/screenshots/00_launch.png). NOTE: Invoke-UwpApp.ps1 returned ok:false ('App registered but is not running') due to a verify-stage timing false negative, but the process was confirmed alive with a visible window and no WER/crash signature. winapp UI Automation could NOT penetrate the UWP CoreWindow (hosted by ApplicationFrameHost; UIA exposes only the top-level Pane), so scenario navigation and per-control actuation on the UWP app were not possible and no behavioral golden exists. UWP-side 'responded:false' therefore means 'unreachable via UIA', not 'dead'.
score_rationale: Harness reported 83.3 (pass=2, partial=1). Manual visual+behavioral review upgrades Scenario 3 to pass: its harness PARTIAL was a structural/label false-negative (the ToggleSwitch is present and identical to the UWP source but displays 'Lamp Off' in its off state and is correctly disabled/hardware-gated with no lamp device; the Register button is functional when targeted by AutomationId). No genuine migration defects were found; all three scenarios reproduce the UWP behavior faithfully. See discrepancies.md.
